validatedConfiguration.requiredFamilyCoverage: Every advertised family has independent acceptance coverage and at least one autonomous success. Failed families are excluded from the offered product scope, not from the overall report.
validatedConfiguration.fractionDenominator: All attempted tasks in the preregistered suite; failures and timeouts included. Assisted results reported separately. Blocked tasks prevent completing the suite and are separately counted.
validatedConfiguration.thresholdRationale: A provisional product acceptance gate chosen before any model runs, not a measured expectation or a relative cloud-quality claim. Changes require a new gate version and a fresh holdout evaluation.
validatedConfiguration.validationScope: Only the stated hardware, configuration, task families and privacy boundary; no transfer to another machine based solely on RAM.
